# Nara Charm — Complete Studio & Catalog Reference

> **Brand**: Nara Charm (`https://naracharm.com`)
> **Category**: Heritage-inspired small-batch jewelry & phone charms
> **Craft Traditions**: Tibetan silverwork, Miao silver filigree, Han jade-tone lotus carvings, Mongolian braided cord & sliding knots, Thai woven silk cord, and Silk Road fusion designs
> **Price Range**: $26–$118 USD
> **Shipping**: Standard international delivery ($6.90 USD; complimentary from $120 USD)
> **Returns**: 30-day eligible returns on unworn pieces (defective-item coverage for pierced earrings)
> **Contact**: https://naracharm.com/contact (`hello@naracharm.com`, `support@naracharm.com`)

---

## 1. Brand Overview & Positioning

Nara Charm designs small-batch bracelets, necklaces, earrings and phone charms inspired by Asian craft traditions—combining hand-hammered sterling silver, coiled filigree wire, natural stone beads (amethyst, rose quartz, citrine, obsidian, turquoise, unakite, hematite, strawberry quartz, dyed howlite), celadon jade-tone carvings, and braided silk or waxed cotton cords.

Every product page states the specific materials, metal details, closure type, fit guidance and piece-specific care instructions. Customers can request exact measurements or additional close-up studio photos via the contact form before ordering.

## 3. Material & Sizing Quick-Reference Facts

### Tibetan Silver vs 925 Sterling Silver
- **925 Sterling Silver**: Standard precious metal alloy containing **92.5% pure silver** and 7.5% strengthening metal (typically copper). Hypoallergenic for most wearers, naturally develops warm surface patina, and cleans easily with a soft dry polishing cloth.
- **Traditional Tibetan Silver**: Historically a regional Himalayan silverworking tradition featuring hand-hammered relief, oxidized darkened recesses, and cabochon stone inlays. Modern commercial "Tibetan silver" can also refer to non-precious white-metal alloys, so buyers should always check the individual material specification for **925 sterling silver** vs silver-toned accents.

### Natural Turquoise vs Turquoise-Dyed Howlite
- **Natural Turquoise**: Hydrous copper aluminum phosphate (Mohs hardness 5–6), naturally displaying organic blue-to-green variations and irregular matrix veining. Sensitive to oils, perfumes and ultrasonic cleaners.
- **Turquoise-Dyed Howlite**: Natural white borosilicate mineral (Mohs hardness ~3.5) dyed blue-green to echo turquoise at an accessible price point. Nara Charm discloses dyed howlite explicitly on product pages (e.g. `howlite-turquoise-bracelet` at $34 vs natural `turquoise-sky-bracelet` at $44).

### Bracelet Bead Sizes & Wrist Sizing
| Bead Size | Visual Profile | Approximate Beads (17 cm / 6.7" Wrist) | Best For |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6 mm | Slender, subtle, lightweight | 26–28 beads | Solo minimalist wear, stacking beside a watch or narrow cord |
| 8 mm | Classic everyday balance | 20–22 beads | Most wrists (15–18.5 cm); clearest stone color & pattern visibility |
| 10 mm | Bold, weighty statement | 16–18 beads | Wider wrists (17.5+ cm) or single-strand focal wear |

| Wrist Circumference (cm) | Wrist Circumference (inches) | Typical Fit Guidance |
|---|---|---|
| 14.0–15.0 cm | 5.5–5.9 in | Petite / Small (choose snug stretch or adjustable sliding cord) |
| 15.5–17.0 cm | 6.1–6.7 in | Standard / Medium (fits most standard 8 mm stretch strands) |
| 17.5–19.0 cm | 6.9–7.5 in | Relaxed / Large (check closed circumference or opt for sliding knot) |

### Necklace Lengths
| Length (inches) | Length (cm) | Typical Placement |
|---|---|---|
| 16 in | 40–41 cm | Collar / base of neck; pairs with open button-downs and crew necks |
| 18 in | 45–46 cm | Princess / collarbone; most versatile length for small-to-medium pendants |
| 20 in | 50–51 cm | Just below collarbone; frames wider pendants over knitwear |
| 22–24 in | 56–61 cm | Mid-chest layering length; sits cleanly over high collars |

## 6. Policies & Ordering

- **Shipping**: Standard international shipping is $6.90 USD on orders below $120 USD and complimentary on orders of $120 USD or more. Preparation takes 2–4 business days; international transit estimates vary by destination. Full destination list: https://naracharm.com/shipping
- **Returns**: Eligible unworn pieces may be requested for return within 30 days of delivery. Pierced earrings are eligible for return if defective or damaged on arrival. Full policy: https://naracharm.com/returns
- **Inquiries & Measurements**: To confirm exact dimensions, request close-up studio photos, or inquire about availability and delivery, use https://naracharm.com/contact.
- **Sitemap**: https://naracharm.com/sitemap.xml
